(3) The employers’ organisation BusinessEurope has designated a candidate for the vacant seat, HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION: Article 1 Mr Martin Steen KABONGO is appointed member of the Management Board of the European Foundation for the improvement of living and working conditions in place of Ms Christiane MIßLBECK-WINBERG for the remainder of the current term of office, ending on 31 March 2027. Article 2 This Decision shall enter into force on the date of its adoption. Done at Brussels, 10 July 2026. For the Council The President S. HARRIS ( 1 ) OJ L 30, 31.1.2019, p. 74 .
